title: "Achieve the best result in the shortest amount of time"
author: Neal Mitchell
content:
Niki Lauda, Three-Time Formula 1 World Driving Champion, Dies at 70

“What drives me crazy is the amount of talking that goes on. I like to make my life simple. I get straight to the point. If it's my mistake, it's my mistake. In motor racing, you learn to achieve the best result in the shortest amount of time. It applies in life too. Be quicker than the others. And don't make mistakes. Even if things fail, have the discipline to find a new way, rather than embarking on a pointless emotional journey." Niki Lauda

Was sorry to hear the news of Niki Lauda’s passing. I found his quote (above) to be insightful and full of wisdom. He sums up the concepts behind being fast and continuous learning.
